full_page.content:
Page 220 Cont.
July Mrs. Earnest LaBrecque - 50 - inward groth or tuomer, on back from early in May till July 31. Enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc. 50c. Drs. hopeless - was advised to read City of God ... could not read other material without sleeping - "City of God" however, She could read for hours at a time.
Mrs. Pauline Morowski - 56 - Enemia and gall-bl. disturbence Daniel Scola - 25 - in Eloise nerveous Clare Kaiser - 39 - tuomer in jaw - six operations - 3 since Sept. at Mayo Clinic ... fears further operation. Enrolls - and promises The young man - 22 - drowned.
Martin J. Ford - 28 - neglecting wife and Family
Page 221 July 4 Jeannine Kettke - 11 - Lukemia - lutherin (See 6th)
4 John Cerilli - 27 - fell down cellar when about six (yrs. old) has never fully recovered his speech ..... Enrolled Today ... 1.00
Thanks ... Baby Henry Martin 10 mo. - see last week - much improved
6 Mary Ann Lambrecht - 8 mo. bright baby but becoming very thin - Drs. puzzeeled. Enrolled this evening for 2 yrs.
6 Mrs. Pearl Mulligan - 39 - had breast removed about a year ago. Drs. hopeless in her regard. Was enrolled about six weeks ago. Made trip to Prince E'd Isle ... feeling fine - has every hope.
Dr. Wm. Hipp - 60 - not Cath. - fears Spine - Enrolled Today 50c
Page 222 July Dr. S. B. Waligora - 54 of Chicago - paralyzed 13 yrs ..... Thomas Dunaj - 4 - has never spoken - quite doubtful if he hears - bright.
Mrs. Mae (Murray) Ache. ...
Mary Hayes - 19 - T.B.
